heading: Approval of applications

tree.heading: Criteria
tree.text: The State shall establish criteria for approval of applications under this section. Such criteria shall include—

children.text: consideration of the local district’s need for, and inability to locally provide for, the activities, equipment, library and instructional materials requested;
the number and nature of elementary and secondary students who will benefit from the planned program; and
the expressed level of financial and in-kind commitment from other parties to the program.

tree.heading: Approval procedures
tree.text: The State shall adopt approval procedures designed to ensure that grants are equitably distributed among—

children.text: rural, urban, and suburban areas; and
small, medium, and large local educational agencies.
